Crime & Law · India

Youth Protest Over NEET Exam Sees Clashes, Arrests, and Solidarity

Protests erupted across India concerning the NEET exam, with thousands participating in demonstrations. In Delhi, a protest at Jantar Mantar saw clashes, resulting in an Assistant Commissioner of Police being injured by stone-pelting. Police arrested three Muslim men in Assam for allegedly planning a protest in solidarity with the youth movement. In Kolkata, a lathi-charge occurred during a protest. Left-leaning outlets highlighted the judiciary's role in checking police excess and reported on detentions and solidarity protests in Assam. Right-leaning outlets focused on the stone-pelting incident and the injury to a police officer.
